items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: The first alto player that was with Joe Furco at the Lowest State was the first alto sax, Italian boy.

ctx.x: And we used to go, I used to go out there in the afternoon with my daddy and I'd get lost

from listening to the military band and I'd go over and listen to Johnny Beisdorf, his jazz band. I believe that. I was a band. I was a band. I was a band. I was a band. I was a band. I was a band. I was a band. I was a band. I was a band. I was a band. I was a band. I never did get in. Well, I was in Tokyo Garden. Tokyo, Tokyo Tea, Tokyo Tea Gardens. Yeah. And I never got the chance.
